verdict.rationale: Algolia is a hosted search SaaS that stores a copy of customer data, so data region or residency is a fair axis. The pack never documents choosing a storage region or residency. The only nearby item describes a Distributed Search Network that routes requests to the closest servers, which is about latency and request routing, not choosing where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
